scenarios.prompt_context: The customer is buying gifts for friends or family and may need wrapping, presentation, and items to complement what is already in the cart.
The customer is preparing to host guests at home.
The customer has just moved into a new, empty home.
The customer has recently brought a cat home and needs pet essentials.
The customer is trying to eat healthier snacks and staples.
The customer is doing a routine grocery restock with no special situation.
The customer is setting up to cook a special meal and needs cookware and ingredients.
The customer is heading out to a concert or gig and needs snacks, drinks, and on-the-go essentials.
The customer is packing for a road trip or short weekend away and needs travel-friendly food and supplies.
The customer is throwing a house party and needs drinks, snacks, and supplies for a crowd at home.
The customer is planning a cozy movie night at home and wants snacks, drinks, and comfort food.
The customer is celebrating someone's birthday and needs cake, treats, and small party supplies.
The customer is recovering from a heavy night out and wants hydrating drinks, comfort food, and easy meals.
The customer is working from home all week and needs coffee, quick meals, and desk-side snacks.
The customer is restarting a gym or fitness routine and wants protein, healthy snacks, and workout recovery food.
The customer is caring for someone unwell at home and needs soups, fluids, and easy comfort food.
The customer is expecting or has just had a baby and needs newborn essentials and easy meals for tired parents.
The customer has a new flatmate moving in and needs shared kitchen staples and household basics.
The customer is pulling an exam or work deadline all-nighter and needs caffeine, quick food, and late-night snacks.
The customer is preparing for monsoon season and needs rain gear, drying supplies, and hot comfort food.
The customer is planning a picnic or day out and needs portable snacks, drinks, and easy-to-carry food.
The customer is doing a deep clean of the home and needs cleaning supplies, gloves, and trash bags.
The customer is spending the weekend on an ambitious cooking project and needs fresh ingredients and kitchen staples.
The customer is meal-prepping breakfasts for the week ahead and needs eggs, bread, fruit, and pantry staples.
The customer is planning a date night at home and wants wine, dessert, and ingredients for a nice dinner.
